name: Ghost Land
source:
You will play a "young and promising" aristocratic teenager.
He took over a dilapidated puppet store from his father.
Every time you open a shop, you should prepare snacks for your guests.
Continuous updates and new dolls on the shelves.

You'll encounter all kinds of headache "VIPs" in the store.

A noble king's mistress
Innocent and kind adventurer
Young bamboo horses and plums
And...

Their temper is elusive.
In order to preserve his father's reputation,
In order to hone their skills,
Please spend all your time thinking about their preferences.
With delicate gifts,
Or some necessary little tricks

When "VIPs" come home with a full load,
When night comes, you'll get something unexpected.
Special Remuneration~

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演一位「年輕有為」的貴族少年。
他從父親手中接過了一家破舊的人偶店。
每次開店前，都要為客人準備點心，
還要不斷更新商品，上架新的人偶。

你會在店裡遇到各種令人頭疼的「貴賓」。

高貴的國王情婦，
天真善良的冒險者，
兩小無猜的青梅竹馬，
還有……

她們的脾氣難以捉摸。
為了維護父親的聲譽，
為了磨練自己的技藝，
請盡心揣摩她們的喜好。
送上精緻的禮物，
或使些必要的小手段。

當「貴賓」們滿載而歸，
夜幕降臨時，你將獲得意想不到的
特別報酬～

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1109110/]Steam[/url]]
